subject: Thoughts for [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following [COMPANY]'s growth - over 100 autonomous stores live is
hugely impressive.

With so many multi-camera environments and complex behavioural models in
play, scaling calibration and surfacing rare edge cases across deployments
must be a challenge.

Encord helps teams like Standard AI speed up CV development by unifying
data curation, annotation, and model evaluation in one platform - so you
can automate video throughput and keep QA tight at scale.

Would you be open to 30 minute call next week to see if Encord is a good
fit?

subject: Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working closely with teams in medical robotics - including
Asensus Surgical - helping them go beyond annotation to build tighter ML
feedback loops: identifying model failure points and curating the right
data for re-training.

In regulated environments, that second part tends to be where things get
messy. Our built-in QA workflows with specialist medical annotators have
made a real difference there.

I'd love to hear where [COMPANY] is on its AI journey and whether
there's a fit. Do you have 30 minutes free next week to connect?

subject: Tensor Robocar - Perception Model
text:
Hi [NAME], 

           Congrats on the Lyft partnership! Super excited to see the future of 
           Tensor Robocars. 

           I imagine things are moving fast given your target delivery date by the end of [YEAR]. With hundreds of robocars streaming from thousands of sensors - syncing, labeling, and QAing multi-modal data can get complicated. We're seeing many AV/ADAS teams moving from multi-tool stacks (CVAT, Voxel 51, Segments + services from Scale) toward a single data platform like Encord to consolidate curation, annotation, QA, model eval, and labeling services as well! 

           Quick context: Encord is a data layer scale up ($50M Series B backed by Nex47 & YC) supporting leading physical AI teams like Boston Dynamics and Physical Intelligence. Most recently, we've been working with Woven by Toyota (video annotation & LiDAR visualisation), Nexar, and Motive on developing ADAS/road safety vision models.

           Would love your feedback on what we've built. How's your calendar looking like next week for a quick chat?

subject: Coffee this week in NYC?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I know you were in contact with Encord before - wanted to reach out again.

Incredible milestone with Physical Intelligence! 96.4% autonomous operation
over a full shift. As you scale further, how are you thinking about data
quality for "long tail" 3.6% of edge cases?

Encord (Series C, $110M total raised) helps Physical AI teams improve data
quality at scale. We work with Pick & Place teams like Boston Dynamics,
